en.askTitle: Put in your own city, budget and commute and get the same e-bike shortlist with the full starter cost
en.runTitle: A Portland commuter, 16 miles a day with hills and rain, wants an e-bike under USD 1,500 in March 2027

fields.label: Daily distance and hills
fields.value: 8 miles each way, with some hills

fields.label: Work charging
fields.placeholder: e.g. can charge at my desk, or no outlet at work

en.template: Help me shortlist a commuter e-bike for {where}, with {budget}, {distance}, {body}, {stairs}, {charging} and {rain}. Compare the full starter cost, carrying weight, likely range and current buying terms. Flag what I should confirm before paying; do not buy or apply for anything.

phases.title: Check five affordable bikes, safety notices and Oregon incentives from public sources
phases.note: Prices and stock, specs, recalls, rebates and tax
phases.judgment: It would not count on a rebate. The advice is to budget the March 2027 purchase without subtracting one: Portland’s programme depends on income limits that expire 31 December 2026, and Oregon’s “no sales tax” still comes with a $15 bicycle tax on new e-bikes.

phases.title: Work out costs and write the recommendations as a linked page
phases.judgment: It corrected a figure that is often quoted. Lectric’s support table gives 49 lb (XP Lite2) and 51.6 lb (XPress Lite) with the battery, not the often-quoted 41 and 45.6 lb, and the page warns that folding does not mean easy to carry up stairs.

phases.title: Check the page and deliver the shortlist and sources

workers: Read the official listings for three of the bikes (Lectric XP Lite2, Lectric XPress Lite, Ride1Up Portola) for current price, stock, specs and weight
Checked Portland and Oregon e-bike rebates, the Oregon bicycle tax, and official safety recall notices for every bike on the list

chipNames.https://help.lectricebikes.com/l/en/arti: Lectric support: how much the bikes weigh
chipNames.https://portlandebikerebate.com/standard: Portland Rides: who can apply and what is covered
chipNames.https://www.oregon.gov/dor/programs/busi: Oregon Department of Revenue: bicycle excise tax

zh.askTitle: 填入你自己的城市、预算和通勤情况，同样拿到电助力车候选清单和买齐上路的总费用
zh.runTitle: 波特兰通勤族，每天往返 16 英里，有坡有雨，想在 2027 年 3 月买一辆 1,500 美元以内的电助力车

fields.label: 地点和购买日期
fields.value: 美国俄勒冈州波特兰；2027 年 3 月购买

fields.label: 每日距离和坡道
fields.value: 单程 8 英里，有一些坡

fields.label: 身高和内侧腿长
fields.value: 身高 5 英尺 7 英寸，体重 160 磅

fields.label: 单位充电条件
fields.placeholder: 例如：办公桌旁可以充电，或单位没有插座

zh.template: 请按{where}、{budget}、{distance}、{body}、{stairs}、{charging}和{rain}，帮我筛选通勤电助力车。比较买齐上路装备的总费用、搬运重量、可能续航和当前购买条款，提醒我付款前还要确认什么；不要购买或代申请。

phases.title: 从公开资料核对五款平价车、安全通报和俄勒冈的优惠政策
phases.note: 价格与库存、规格、召回、补贴和税费
phases.judgment: 它不指望补贴。建议在预算 2027 年 3 月的购买时不要先扣掉补贴：波特兰项目看收入上限，而公布的上限在 2026 年 12 月 31 日到期；俄勒冈虽然没有销售税，新电助力车仍要交 15 美元的自行车税。

phases.title: 算出费用，写成带来源链接的推荐页面
phases.judgment: 它更正了一个常被引用的数字。Lectric 的官方支持表写的是连电池 49 磅（XP Lite2）和 51.6 磅（XPress Lite），而不是常被引用的 41 磅和 45.6 磅，页面还提醒：能折叠不等于好搬上楼。

phases.title: 检查页面，交付候选清单和来源

workers: 读取其中三款车（Lectric XP Lite2、Lectric XPress Lite、Ride1Up Portola）的官方商品页，核对现价、库存、规格和重量
核对波特兰和俄勒冈州的电助力车补贴、俄勒冈的自行车税，以及清单上每款车的官方召回通知
